items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: me and had worked from time to time as a teacher of mine, and whom I liked very much

ctx.x: Well I'll tell you there were some of them, two other fellas that more or less inspired

me and had worked from time to time as a teacher of mine, and whom I liked very much, and liked the styles very much. I don't know whether you've had the occasion to meet a fellow by the name of Albert Gishard. No. But he played with the Robichaud unit. They had a terrific unit there. That was during the time when they used to work at a place on Rampart Street called the Paradise Inn.
